Governments Urged to Negotiate Paramilitary Disbandment

A report suggests that the British and Irish governments should formally negotiate the disbandment of paramilitary groups in Northern Ireland. The report identifies a "window of opportunity" to establish such a process involving both loyalist and republican organizations. This call for a formal transition mechanism has been made to the governments.
